The owner's brief of 2026-10-12, campaigns/majordomus-incremental-derive-prompt-pack/README.md, asks for the full regeneration to be replaced by a typed, content-addressed, incremental derivation graph without weakening the full derivation or the freshness checks; its pages <n1/> to <n2/>, <n3/>, <n4/>, <n5/> and <n6/> are what this milestone plans.

A key the record does not carry is `unknown`, never an empty string: `objective: ""` and a record with no objective are the same string and different facts. An id the model does not declare is answered, not refused. `git: false` answers from the records alone, which is what a comparison across machines wants.

Klíč, který záznam nenese, je `unknown`, nikdy prázdný řetězec: `objective: ""` a záznam bez objective jsou stejný řetězec a různé fakty. en: <t1/> already says the capability registry "indexes the tool's own surface … and is derived from the layer and the code on every start", and that a capability which reports as it goes, called once, is an <t2>execution</t2>. A scripted capability is a capability declared in a file of the layer instead of in Rust code, whose handler is a Rhai script instead of a compiled function. It is discovered by the index like any other object of the layer, becomes a capability in the one registry, and from there reaches every surface by the projections that already exist — the command line, the HTTP route, the OpenAPI operation, the MCP tool, the Cockpit's generated runner form, the generated reference. Adding one registers it nowhere.

Skriptovaná schopnost je schopnost deklarovaná v souboru vrstvy místo v kódu Rustu, jejíž handler je skript Rhai místo zkompilované funkce. Index ji objeví jako každý jiný objekt vrstvy, stane se schopností v jednom registru a odtud dosáhne každého povrchu existujícími projekcemi — příkazová řádka, trasa HTTP, operace OpenAPI, nástroj MCP, generovaný formulář spouštěče v Cockpitu, generovaná reference. en: <t1/> answers what the next free identity is, and says what it looked at to decide. Four sources, each reporting how many identities it claimed: this working tree, every sibling worktree as it stands on disk (authored and not yet committed is a real claim), every ref — branches, tags, remote-tracking refs and every linked worktree's <t2/>, in one <t3/> — and the peer board of the shared server, which is the only source that knows about an identity a session has decided to take and has not written anywhere. A source that could not be reached is reported as unreachable and never dropped silently from the denominator. Allocation is <t4>monotonic</t4>: one above the highest identity anything has ever claimed, never into a hole. A hole means an identity was taken and withdrawn, or taken and not yet written, and nothing can tell either from a number nobody ever used — <t5/> of this repository is on no branch, in no tag and in no working tree, and <t6/> cites it. Holes are therefore listed as spent, with whatever cites them named as evidence for the reader. The shell tool has no peer identity of its own, so a session that announced an allocation and then asks is stepped over its own claim; the output says when the high-water mark came from a board claim. <t7/> allocates through the same survey.
cs: <t1/> odpovídá, jaká je další volná identita, a říká, na co se při rozhodování podíval. Čtyři zdroje, z nichž každý hlásí, kolik identit si nárokoval: tento pracovní strom, každý sourozenecký worktree tak, jak je na disku (autorsky napsané a dosud necommitnuté je skutečný nárok), každý ref — větve, tagy, remote-tracking refy a <t2/> každého propojeného worktree, v jednom <t3/> — a nástěnka peerů sdíleného serveru, která je jediným zdrojem, jenž ví o identitě, kterou se relace rozhodla vzít a nikam ji nezapsala. Zdroj, který nebylo možné oslovit, se hlásí jako nedostupný a nikdy se mlčky nevypouští ze jmenovatele. Alokace je <t4>monotónní</t4>: o jedna nad nejvyšší identitou, kterou kdy cokoli nárokovalo, nikdy do mezery. Mezera znamená, že identita byla vzata a stažena, nebo vzata a dosud nezapsána, a nic nepozná jedno či druhé od čísla, které nikdo nikdy nepoužil — <t5/> tohoto repozitáře není na žádné větvi, v žádném tagu ani v žádném pracovním stromu a <t6/> ji cituje.
